metadataReview.note: Reviewed battlefield location: the Municipality of Kokašice places the 6 May 1680 fighting on Ovčí vrch and explicitly states that the chapel was built on the battlefield. The Municipality of Otročín publishes the chapel/monument GPS point. Coordinates identify that documented battlefield landmark, not an exact battle perimeter or surveyed troop position. Existing day-precision date is retained.
